subject.title: bug: withAllowedHostname only updates allowedHostnames, not hostnameAllowlist — breaks navigate with non-empty hostnameAllowlist

question: Should the fix relax `withAllowedHostname` to cover both hostname fields, or should Playwright navigate/session code pass a distinct CDP-control policy while leaving page-navigation policy unchanged?
rationale: The issue is source-reproducible, but the repair changes how browser SSRF policy distinguishes OpenClaw control-plane CDP traffic from page navigation, and existing tests encode part of the stricter behavior.

options.title: Use Scoped CDP Control Policy
options.body: Pass the resolved CDP-control policy into Playwright connection and target lookup paths so local control traffic cannot self-block while page navigation remains strict.

options.title: Broaden The Helper
options.body: Make `withAllowedHostname` add the exact host to both `allowedHostnames` and `hostnameAllowlist`, accepting a broader helper-level semantic change that must be audited across all callers.

options.title: Keep Strict Operator Burden
options.body: Keep current behavior and document that users with `hostnameAllowlist` must also include the local CDP host, preserving the existing test expectation.

recommendation.title: Use Scoped CDP Control Policy
recommendation.body: Pass the resolved CDP-control policy into Playwright connection and target lookup paths so local control traffic cannot self-block while page navigation remains strict.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the shared helper and have the most direct recent history across the implicated helper and CDP policy files.
